tabs.aspectHint: This forum's icon, title, tag, accent bar, background and badge. Everything works in any theme; with the plugin off, the forum looks default.
tabs.categoryHint: The category's title band: icon, title, tag and background (compact, ~64 px).
tabs.widgetHint: The widget's title band: icon, coloured title, tag, accent bar and background under a veil.

icon.normalHint: Replaces the Font Awesome icon; shown in the theme's tile, round or square.
icon.unreadHint: Empty: the normal one is used, with an outline.

tag.textHint: For example Important, Official, Recruiting, Popular. Empty: no tag.

accent.hint: In the “Separate cards” layout it stays the theme's small bar. Empty: no bar.

badge.label: Badge as a sub-forum
badge.hint: Shown next to its name in the sub-forum list. “Automatic”: ON / OFF from the linked server's status (Servers app).

bg.imageHint: At least 1600×240 px recommended. Only your own images; no third-party images are bundled.
bg.inheritHint: A sub-forum with its own background keeps it.
